$comment: Cases that do not match Node yet, by target, each with its cause. The diff run reports them without failing, and fails when one matches Node so it is removed here. Owners: the Kotlin translator (src/kotlin.ts) and runtime (kit-android runtime).

swift.243-array-holes: An array key that is no index (`a[1.5] = v`) is left out of Object.keys (Swift runtime).
swift.247-missing-values-throw: A module const read before its declaration runs, and a member of undefined or null read, set or called, trap instead of throwing ReferenceError or TypeError (Swift translator, quality step 4).
swift.363-operator-pipe: Does not compile: an overloaded generic method with an `any` implementation (`pipe(...operators: OperatorFunction<any, any>[])`) is called as the implementation (`Stream<T>` assigned to `Stream<Any?>`, no `adapting` from the operator's function type), and an overload's function argument names the implementation's type parameter `T` (Swift translator).
swift.620-interface-identity: Refused: an untyped object converted to an interface's class (a copy) where the code compares it by identity, looks it up as a key, or a callee keeps it (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
swift.621-optional-callback-adapting: Lenient app code: a function literal returning null where its function type gives an array does not compile: the closure's Swift result, `JSArray<Double>`, holds no null (null in typed values, Unit 22) (Swift translator).
swift.626-array-parameter-mutation: Refused: an untyped or typed array given to a number[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
swift.662-untyped-array-parameter: Refused: an untyped array given to a number[] or string[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts); Kotlin passes it as is only when its elements already are the type, which a build cannot know.
swift.862-json-unrepresentable: A lone surrogate JSON.parse reads from an escape becomes U+FFFD, since Swift strings hold only valid Unicode; and JSON.stringify recurses per nesting level, so 5000 nested arrays exceed the stack (RangeError) where V8 writes them iteratively (Swift runtime limits).
swift.863-string-lone-surrogate-literal: A string literal holding a lone surrogate is refused: a Swift string cannot hold one (Swift translator).
swift.891-generic-class-fields-as-interface: Refused (build error): a generic class whose field or getter typed by its type parameter meets a generic interface's field, held as the interface; Swift can't overload a property by its type (Swift translator).
swift.892-define-property-declared-field: Refused (build error): Object.defineProperty making a class's declared field an accessor, read-only, hidden or fixed, which the class's Swift field keeps none of (Swift translator).
swift.939-regexp-unset-groups-typed-callback: Refused (build error): a function value whose element parameter is declared `string` (no undefined), given to visit strings a pattern's unset group may leave undefined; declaring it `string | undefined` compiles (lang.ts unsetGroupTyping.typedCallback).
swift.945-regexp-lone-surrogates: A match that starts or ends inside a surrogate pair, or an input holding a lone surrogate, gives a lone surrogate, which a Swift String cannot hold: it becomes U+FFFD (documented limit, like 862; Swift runtime).

kotlin.252-prototype-method-calls: A built-in's prototype method called with call or apply (`Array.prototype.slice.call(list, 1)`) is refused, test262 cluster 2 (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.254-destructuring-assignment: A rest element in a destructuring assignment (`[first, ...others] = list`) is refused, test262 cluster 8 (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.620-interface-identity: Refused: an untyped object converted to an interface's class (a copy) where the code compares it by identity, looks it up as a key, or a callee keeps it (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
kotlin.621-optional-callback-adapting: Lenient app code: a function literal returning null where its type gives an array gives undefined, not null (Kotlin translator; null vs undefined in typed values).
kotlin.626-array-parameter-mutation: Refused: an untyped or typed array given to a number[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts).
kotlin.662-untyped-array-parameter: Refused: an untyped array given to a number[] or string[] parameter its callee writes to is converted into a copy (preflight, src/sharing.ts); Kotlin passes it as is only when its elements already are the type, which a build cannot know.
kotlin.891-generic-class-fields-as-interface: Refused (build error): a generic class's field typed by its type parameter meeting a generic interface's writable field, which the interface erases to any value (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.892-define-property-declared-field: Refused (build error): Object.defineProperty making a class's declared field an accessor, read-only, hidden or fixed, which the class's Kotlin field keeps none of (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.939-regexp-unset-groups-typed-callback: Refused (build error): a function value whose element parameter is declared `string` (no undefined), given to visit strings a pattern's unset group may leave undefined; declaring it `string | undefined` compiles (lang.ts unsetGroupTyping.typedCallback).
